Use structured worklogs as the source of truth; record meaningful observations, add implementation tasks before code changes, and finish or cancel tasks before reporting completion.

The mobile app is an Expo/React Native iPhone-first MVP with current capabilities split conceptually into connection/home and session views, but the README flow still describes stacked setup panels for browsing host/path/session data.

The app runs Expo SDK ~54.0.25 with React Native 0.81.5 and currently has no expo-router, React Navigation, react-native-screens, or safe-area-context direct dependencies; package main is the custom index.ts entry.

All app UI and state are concentrated in one 2030-line file. Navigation is controlled by a state.screen union and a conditional render inside App, so connection/setup UI stacks recents, host form, workspace form, path explorer, and sessions in a single ScrollView column.

The app view model exposes only two screens, 'connection' and 'session'; opening a session sets screen='session' and showConnection sets screen='connection'. It has no route stack or per-flow navigation state.

Prior UX research identified the main gap as native-feeling phone navigation: promote recents to home/dashboard, replace stacked setup panels with progressive drill-down flows/sheets, and make session navigation feel like a proper mobile route.

Previous implementation intentionally avoided a navigation dependency and only collapsed manual setup behind a Browse host/path toggle; the current user feedback indicates that lightweight custom state was not enough and a real navigation package is now appropriate.

Expo Router 6.0.15 matches Expo SDK 54-era dependencies: it depends on React Navigation native/bottom-tabs/native-stack and expects Expo/React/React Native plus expo-linking, expo-constants, react-native-screens, and react-native-safe-area-context peers.

Expo CLI supports `expo install` with pnpm auto-detection and chooses SDK-compatible dependency versions, making it the safer path for adding Expo Router support to the current Expo SDK rather than pinning latest SDK-55 router packages manually.
Started from feat/mobile-session-navigation-recents with only the new structured worklog untracked, then created branch feat/expo-router-navigation-pages for this implementation.
